o.norm: Unexpected end of string while decoding \uFFFF -> -1\r

i.norm: Builds a converter whose only encoding maps the code point -1 to a long string. Because that encoded value is long, the converter's encoded-letter length is large. Decoding a short input that does not start with a known encoded letter therefore runs past the end of the string before a full encoded group can be read, which is reported as an {@link UnsupportedEncodingException}.
A single mapping: code point -1 -> a long encoded string.
The input is far shorter than the converter's encoded-letter length, so decoding cannot read a full encoded group and must fail.
Unexpected end of string while decoding "￿ -> -1\r".
